name: KGB Super Spy
summary: KGB Superspy sends you into a risky helicopter rescue mission behind enemy lines. Across several operations, you pick up scientists, carry them to safe houses, and eventually attempt the dangerous border flight to the West. Soldiers, tanks, jeeps, and jetpack enemies stand in your way, while fuel and energy always need careful attention. The mission becomes especially tense through disguised decoys, limited resources, and the constant shift between rescue, combat, and navigation.
